title: Ollama Tool Calling Agents: No LangChain Required
excerpt: A silently truncated context window turned off my agent's tools with zero errors. Here's the native Ollama API shape, the agent loop, and the fix, no LangChain required.
seo_title: Ollama Tool Calling Agents: No LangChain Required
meta_description: Learn how Ollama tool calling agents work without LangChain: the native API shape, a minimal loop, and the bug that silently breaks tool calls.
social_message:
My local agent went quiet on me. No errors, no crash, just a model that forgot it had tools.

Turns out Ollama tool calling agents don't need LangChain, just /api/chat and about 40 lines of Python. The real trap: the OpenAI-compatible endpoint silently drops num_ctx, so your tool schemas get truncated out of context before the model ever reads them.

Read the full guide 👉 https://www.firstevolvenextscale.com/ollama-tool-calling-agents/
